Default.competeInSnowballFights: Compete in snowball fights to collect items — chocolates, marshmallows and mugs — and brew the most hot chocolate. Whoever has the most points at the end wins!
Default.everyItemYouClaim: Every item you claim is worth points. The player holding the most marshmallow cards at the end also earns a +40 point bonus!
Default.eachRoundYouSecretly: Each round you secretly load a snowball (harmless) or a stoneball — a snowball packed with a rock that injures whoever it hits. Your stoneballs are limited, so aim them wisely!
Default.everyoneAimsAtAnother: Everyone aims at another player at the same time, then you'll see who is targeting you. Each round one player is the Snow Queen — she can force someone aiming at her to switch to a different target!
Default.stayInTheFight2: Stay in the fight — or run
Default.onceTargetsAreFinal: Once targets are final, choose to stay in the fight or run away. Run away and you're safe, but you earn no items this round. The only way to score is to stay and dodge every stoneball coming your way!
Default.getHitByA: Get hit by a stoneball and you're injured. Your name is color-coded: green (healthy), orange (1 injury), red (2). A 3rd injury costs you half your points — then you reset to green.
Default.survivorsWhoWerenT: Survivors who weren't hit take turns claiming items from the center. Watch for special cards — Heal Once, Full Health, an extra Stoneball, and the Snow Queen card for next round. Review it all anytime via the Cheatsheet!
